observations: jj behaviour surfaced by the rewritten stale-workspace test, not changed here: `jj workspace update-stale` loads the repo at the workspace's last-recorded operation and snapshots there on a divergent operation before reconciling (`Concurrent modification detected, resolving automatically`). When a bookmark sits on an unsnapshotted `@` at that recorded operation and the main line has moved or deleted it, the reconciliation conflicts the bookmark (`- base + A + B`) — reproduced on 0.44 and 0.45. The old unconditional `bookmark set` masked it by force-resolving to `@`. In production a worker's first jj command snapshots `.omp/config.yml` on the main line, so the window is a fresh workspace no worker ever touched whose bookmark was then moved from elsewhere. The test snapshots (`jj status`) after the first provision, as spec acceptance 2 requires for the merged-branch shape; the comment in the test says why.

Plan Task 5 Step 3 (production op-log check on the live daemon's clone) is post-merge; not run. Today the live clone still shows a `point bookmark legion/<KEY>` per resume (the old code moved this very workspace's legion/LEGION-70 onto my `@` at spawn; I set it back to `@-` before each push).

LEGION-44 also edits the provisioning argv lists in workspace.test.ts and processes.test.ts (appends `jj config list --repo` probes after the git credential writes); whichever PR lands second rebases over a textual conflict there (architect's note).
forTester: Repeat the E2E driver independently (fix and negative control) and add the merged-branch shape: provision, `jj status` in the workspace (snapshot — required, see the F5 note in the plan and the observation above), push the bookmark to origin, `git --git-dir=<remoteDir>/.git branch -D legion/WIDGETS-42`, provision again → `jj -R <repoCloneDir> bookmark list legion/WIDGETS-42` prints nothing; with main's file it prints the bookmark at the workspace's `@`.
